question: Must this security-sensitive workflow demonstrate a live same-request retry with no duplicate mutation, or are the two successful exact-head publications plus focused idempotency tests sufficient?
rationale: The normal isolated publication path is proven and the patch appears correct, but the PR explicitly claims retry idempotency and only maintainers can accept test-backed evidence instead of a real rerun.

options.title: Require live retry proof
options.body: Rerun one successful exact-head workflow request and show the existing marker produces an unchanged result without another mutation.

options.title: Accept test-backed idempotency
options.body: Approve the exact-head normal-path runs and focused marker/idempotency tests as sufficient evidence for merge.

recommendation.title: Require live retry proof
recommendation.body: Rerun one successful exact-head workflow request and show the existing marker produces an unchanged result without another mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the assist lane and authored this credential-boundary change, making him the clearest owner of the proof threshold.
